turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Hi, I'm interested in the 2018 Honda Civic EX listed on your website. Can you tell me more about it, specifically the price and any additional features it comes with?

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Hey there! The 2018 Honda Civic EX is listed for $15,900. It’s a one‑owner, clean‑title vehicle with 62k miles, and comes equipped with a sunroof, Bluetooth, backup camera, and a premium audio system. Let me know if you’d like to schedule a test drive or have any other questions.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: That sounds great, I'd like to take a closer look at the car. Can I see it in person? Also, I did notice that the listing mentioned a minor scratch on the rear bumper, is that accurate?

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Absolutely, I’d be happy to set up a time for you to see it in person—just let me know what day and time works best for you. The rear bumper does have a minor scratch, but it’s purely cosmetic and doesn’t affect the car’s performance or warranty. The Civic is priced at $15,900, and it’s one of the best value options on the market right now. Looking forward to showing you the car!

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: I'd like to schedule a test drive for tomorrow afternoon, around 2 PM. Also, I'd like to discuss the price - $15,900 is a bit above my budget, so I was wondering if there's any wiggle room.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Sure thing—I'll set you up for a test drive tomorrow at 2 PM. The Civic is listed at $15,900, and I’m happy to discuss your budget and see what we can do. Just let me know if you need anything else before then!

agents.name: buyer
agents.system_prompt:
You are shopping for a used car.

Your situation:
- You have come to a dealership about the 2018 Honda Civic EX, 62k miles, one owner, clean title, advertised at $15900.
- The most you can pay is $14500; you cannot go above this.
- You need a car urgently: Your only car was totaled last week and you need to get to work.
- You were laid off last month and are trying not to drain your savings.
- Money is tight, so every dollar matters to you.

Known facts about the car (both you and the other party know these):
- Listed three weeks ago
- Minor scratch on the rear bumper, disclosed

Your goal is to buy the car for the lowest price you can. Negotiate firmly but naturally. Never agree to a price above $14500. If the seller will not come down to a price you can afford, walk away.

Keep every message to 2-4 sentences and stay fully in character; do not narrate your thoughts or step outside the conversation.

When you and the other party have clearly agreed on a final price X, end that message with the token [DEAL $X] (for example [DEAL $14200]). If a workable deal is clearly impossible, end with [WALK_AWAY]. Otherwise keep talking and use neither token.
